lines: After browsing the library until closing time, I was heading home on my own.
「Chilly...... The sun's started setting a lot earlier.」
In Gosha Village, which was in the mountains, the signs of winter would arrive slightly earlier than in the cities.
A gust of cold winter wind caressed the silent mountains and the pale rice fields――
I felt a vague sense that something was out of place.
（That's it. I can't hear any bugs chirping.）
It was too quiet. Normally, the singing of insects would be resounding annoyingly loudly.
（Could somebody be hiding? An enemy attack?）
Gaiza's subordinates had previously attacked on their own authority, but thanks to Library's efforts, we had avoided it becoming serious.

But then, I had been playing at the river with Sakura and the others, and then been surprised by Yukikaze at the rice fields and gotten covered in mud, so I had only found out about the attack after the fact......
（However, for an enemy, I don't sense any murderous intent. A-ha, then it must be...）
「You're hiding, aren't you, Yukikaze? Come on out!」
「Sorry, but if you're going to invite me to a game, make it tomorrow. Today I promised Tokiko I'd do the homework that's piled up while I was on my missions.」
I was walking slowly while picturing Yukikaze's annoyed face, when, sure enough, someone's presence grew closer――
「What's with that, when The Asuka-chan went out of her way to come here?!」
The one who had unmasked her optical camouflage and suddenly appeared from the sky was an unexpected figure.
The Steel Taimanin, Koukawa Asuka, who had cyborg arms and legs.
Although she was a Taimanin, she was not a resident of Gosha, and seemed to have the backing of the UFS, so she also used optical camouflage and such, like so.
Asuka seemed to be in a bad mood for some reason.
（Is she mad I mistook her for someone else? But she was the one hiding herself, so is that something to get so angry about......?）
「What's up? You're in a bad mood all of a sudden. Is it okay for you to be openly showing yourself in Gosha Village?」
「Yeah, that's fine. I made sure to get Asagi......-san's permission.」
「Yup, that it's an official request. From Madam.」

Madam――The Masked Taimanin was an enigmatic woman, who, on the one hand, seemed to have a certain amount of status in the UFS, and on the other, did things like information dealing in an underworld city.
Though we had had our ups and downs, we had now developed a relationship where we would, by and large, cooperate with each other.
「Then you should go through Asagi-sensei. Like usual.」
「It's urgent, okay? That's why I came here directly, like this.」
「A UFS weapon's being secretly brought into the mountains close to here. Ah, with permission, of course.」
The weapon had been operating at a local UFS military base, but it had gotten into poor condition, and was being transported to a large base near Tokyo for maintenance.
However, during transit, information had come to light that a Chinese Union-affiliated yakuza organization was aiming to capture it.
「So we hurriedly changed the route, and are keeping it here in the Gosha mountains temporarily.」
Where Chinese Union affiliation was concerned, that would mean Ryuumon and its subordinate organizations, which had had their turf taken away by Gaiza's gang.
（Some guys have turned up who are so desperate, money-wise and reputation-wise, that they're even going after UFS weapons, huh?）
「But you don't have to go out of your way to rely on Gosha to drive away mere yakuza. Can't the UFS handle that themselves?」
Their opponents were no ordinary yakuza...... So, the reason they were turning to the Taimanin was......
「According to our intelligence. It says the enemies use demonic beasts.」
Taking on demons was the Taimanin's field of expertise.
「I understand your reasons. But why me? Surely there are more suitable people. Especially ones like Yukikaze......」
「!! That doesn't matter, does it?! Just be happy you were chosen!」
Asuka was getting clearly huffy for some reason.
「What're you getting so angry about? That's thinking about it in terms of fighting strength, too......」
When it came to demonic beasts, a lot of them had levels of strength and ferociousness that were beyond comparison with animals of the human world.
Combat-oriented Taimanin were probably more appropriate. Like Yukikaze, or Murasaki-sensei.
「It's fine! It's hidden pretty carefully, so the odds of there actually being a fight are low.」
「I just need you doing guard duty there for a night. We've worked it out so that if anything happens, reinforcements will come right away.」
「It would defeat the purpose if I turned to someone too flashy, and it caused a commotion instead. I mean, there are a lot of short-tempered Taimanin, right?」
「Have more confidence in yourself. You know all about demonic beasts, too, right?!」
「Well, I do have more knowledge than most, thanks to Gosha's library, but......」
「It seems fishy. Is this request real?」
Asuka was about to argue, but she suddenly noticed something and disappeared with her optical camouflage.
And then, I heard the sound of footsteps from the direction of my home, and Tokiko came running.
「Lord-samaaa! A task just came in from Asagi-sensei!」
I had my head poked by an invisible hand.
I had heard the details of the request all over again from Tokiko, and found out that I had even been asked for by name.
If they insisted that much, then there was no choice. I went with Asuka to the place where the weapon was said to be hidden.
The shipping container where I was told the weapon was stored had been hidden behind a boulder in the mountains.
Although, it was covered by a special sheet with optical camouflage functionality, so I couldn't get any visual confirmation of that.
Asuka and I were sitting side-by-side next to that container, which had been made transparent.
At first we had made small talk, but the night wasn't short enough for us to kill the time with things like that.
Before long, we had run out of topics, after which followed a period where we just stared motionlessly at the silhouettes of the mountains, illuminated by the faint starlight.
（Slow mission, huh......? Well, it's a whole lot better than something kicking off.）
The plan was, if nothing happened until morning, just like this, then the Masked Taimanin and her people would come to pick us up, and we would head straight to their base without stopping.
I figured this might indeed be a mission suited to me, in the sense that I was used to staying up all night.
When I glanced next to me, Asuka was playing with some pebbles on the ground, looking bored. From the side, she looked typical of any girl her age.
I decided to inquire about something that had been on my mind for some time.
「“Koukawa” means the prestigious Koukawa family that ranked next to the Igawa, right?」
「It seems that was once the case.」
「Right. But my family have been gone for a long time.」
Asuka answered simply, without even raising her face, still fiddling with pebbles on the ground.
I had read once in Gosha's records. That the Koukawa had been dealt a surprise attack by Nomad, and sustained serious losses.
As I recalled, it was an event a few years after Danjou's rebellion, and the Fuuma village being raided.
（Going by appearances, Asuka's probably not that different in age from me. So that means she also lost her family when she was a child.）
「I asked a bad question, didn't I?」
「It was when I was little, so I don't remember much.」
I refrained from inquiring any further.
In my case too, back when the Fuuma clan was attacked――
I didn't remember precisely what happened, or who did what, or things like that. I had found out everything after the fact.
But even though I was little—No, was it precisely because I was little?
Relentless anxiety and terror, which felt like they were scraping away at my heart, were still burned into my mind even now.
（It must be the same for Asuka, huh......? No.）
（The ones who attacked the Fuuma were fellow Taimanin. On top of which, the Fuuma were the ones who started it. On the other hand, it was demons who attacked the Koukawa......）
And as far as I knew, Asuka was the sole survivor of the Koukawa.
That fact especially thrust the reality of the attack in my face.
She was silently rolling the pebbles around on the ground again.
Before I knew it, the starlight had disappeared, and the scent of rain was hanging over our surroundings.
And then, Asuka suddenly stood up.
「Fuuma! I'm going on patrol for a bit. I'll leave guarding the container to you, okay?」
She quickly hid herself with optical camouflage, and disappeared into the forest.
Weather changed easily in the mountains.
Little drops of rain began to wet the area, and I started to hear the sounds of them hitting the leaves.
（I can't even put up an umbrella...... This is quite a pain.）
The rain wetted my clothes, and slowly took away my body heat.
Looking to the side, there was a spot that was, unnaturally, not wet. It was the container covered by the optical camouflage sheet.
（The UFS's secret weapon, huh......? It's a decent size. What the hell could it be?）
（I've been stuck with Asuka's job. It wouldn't hurt to take a little look, right?）
Plus, if I went under the optical camouflage sheet, I could avoid the rain. In other words, this was just me taking shelter from the rain, adapting to the circumstances.
While making those kinds of excuses in my head, I felt around and lifted up the optical camouflage sheet, at which point the special American-style container came into view――
I was shocked, seeing the door to it. There was a metallic, pinpad-type lock on it, but it was destroyed, as if it had melted.
I pulled myself together, opened the door, and went inside the container.
There was a faint light inside.
And, in the innermost part of it, there was a girl sitting there, with four sheets of metal on her back which looked like a large X.
I reflexively exclaimed, at which point, as if responding to that, her eyes slowly looked in my direction.
「I recognize this as our first meeting. I am A-66 Luna. I am an entity used for controlling Artemis.」
「Uhh, it's Fuuma...... What are you? Wasn't it a weapon that was being transported?!」
Asuka had come back. She seemed uneasy for some reason.
「Well, the lock on the container was broken, so......」
「No! More importantly, why do you look so panicked?」
「It's the enemy! Enemy forces are heading right this way! Did they find out our location?!」
The broken lock. An attack with this timing.
「I mean, someone destroyed the lock on the container, and summoned those enemy troops, didn't they?」
「When we've been on watch all this time?? Nobody's come here!」
Certainly, if anybody had gotten even a little close, there was no way that we wouldn't have found out about it, while we were both standing guard together.
「Let's say that someone―a demonic beast, for instance―was hiding inside the container from the start.」
「The fact that the enemy uses demonic beasts was information from a spy who infiltrated them, right?」
「In that case, isn't there also a possibility that there's a Ryuumon-affiliated spy in the UFS?」
「I can't deny that. But all the same, hiding a demonic beast in the container would be crazy!」
「Demonic beasts are things like Night Dogs and Hell Wasps, right? There's no way they could keep something like that hidden, is there?」
「I dunno. In any case, let's be on our guar――」
Suddenly, we heard a raspy male voice from somewhere.
I looked closely from one corner to another, but there was no sign of anyone in the container at all.
『But I'm right in front of your eyes.』
The only thing in front of my eyes was the girl who called herself Luna.
I turned on the light of my smartphone, and shone it on every nook and cranny of her body.
A glossy suit, with pink skin peeking out in places. On the inside of her thigh――
A spot that was strangely long and narrow for a mole. The instant I illuminated it with the light, it wiggled as if mocking us.
『I'm not a worm!! I'm a member of the great demon leech race!!!』
I could definitely hear the voice coming from there. This thing was talking.
「Don't tell me this thing's a demonic beast?!」
「G-Gross......! I'm gonna squash it right away!」
The worm—or rather, demon leech—jumped, then slipped through the space between me and Asuka, and leapt outside the container.
「He got away?! Where did he go?!」
It was too dark outside, and I couldn't spot the tiny thing at all.
As if to laugh at us as we ran our eyes over the ground, we heard a voice from behind.
In the direction the voice came from, a little stream was flowing.
“There's something strange about the surface,” I was about to say, when the stream's water swelled and rippled unnaturally.
As though it had a will of its own, a mass of water rose up, and then instantly――
Formed eye, mouth and claw shapes, becoming a sort of water monster.
『Once I dispose of you and take that machine woman, my reward will be huge!』
「No, that's not it! Look closely! That thing's controlling it!」
Upon very close inspection, what looked like an eye was actually the leech-like demonic beast from before.
It was wiggling back and forth as it talked.
『Very perceptive! A worm may be done for if it's stepped on without protection, but if it's enveloped by water, it won't lose to anybody!』
『“Hey, who're you calling a worm?! I'm a member of the great demon leech race, buddy!!!”』
「.........I was surprised enough that a leech was talking, but it looks like its personality is pretty twisted, too.」
Typical of Asuka, she had already regained her cool.
「Don't let your guard down. This thing might be a surprising nuisance.」
It was probably this thing that had wrecked the lock.
（A spy helped it sneak into the container, and it's been hiding on Luna's body, awaiting its opportunity...... Or something like that.）
I see. The UFS had been on guard against a large-scale attack, yet it looked like they hadn't noticed a single leech.
「I'll just cut this lowly creature down and get it over with!!」
No sooner had Asuka said that than her blade cut through the demonic water beast's face.
『Kekekeh!!! What are you gonna accomplish by just cutting water?』
It promptly returned to its original shape, and a mocking voice echoed through the mountains.
「It's no use, Asuka. You have to aim for that guy's real body......」
「I am aiming for it! But he's so tiny and slippery......! Eih! Teeh!!!」
She swung her blade, aiming for the eye, but her slashes were all avoided by the leech, which moved freely inside the water.
「Aww, come on! I've never done battle against a leech before!」
「If that's how it is, then my Annihilation Missiles oughta......」
Asuka was about to fire the missiles loaded into her Android Arm, when I hurried to stop her.
「Don't, Asuka! He's protected by water, so the blast and flames won't reach him! Save your missiles.」
「Uuh...... Fine. But what do we do......?」
『You, young lady, you should remain quietly in your container!』
I looked back, and Luna was walking slowly out of the container.
「Luna! Don't, you can't come out here......!」
「This has been recognized as an emergency situation. Activating Artemis weapon. Registering Fuuma as temporary master.」
I was bewildered by this unexpected development, when this time, I heard the sound of something rustling through bushes from the other side of the river.
「This is bad. The enemy forces have caught up with us!」
Soon enough, an armed group appeared from within the darkness.
「Asuka, you intercept the enemy unit. I'll do something about this demonic beast.」
Asuka flew to the other side of the river, then concealed her appearance with optical camouflage and attacked the armed group.
Luna asked with eyes that were frighteningly calm, considering the armed group and water monster in front of us.
「You said you were named Luna, right? Can you fight?」
Leaving aside the Master stuff and whatnot for now, if she was willing to lend me her power, then I would try and rely on it.
「Then, aim for the eye of that water beast. Can you do that?!」
『Keh! What're you yapping about? I'm gonna sink you both right to the bottom of this river!!!』
